sources.purpose: link rediscovery — the attestation archive URL carries a rotating rlkey credential and must be re-scraped from this server-rendered page on every run rather than persisted
sources.verification_note: Re-verified during PLAN-T4: HTTP 200, both Dropbox links with rlkey present in the served HTML. Link rediscovery works as designed.
sources.failure_semantics: If the page is unreachable or contains no link, the epoch records SOURCE_ERROR. A stale persisted rlkey must never be used as a fallback.
sources.fixture_disposition: exempt: credential-bearing. The page's value is the rotating rlkey link it carries, so retaining it would persist a credential this manifest forbids persisting, and a sanitised copy would no longer be the artifact. Retrieval is verified live instead.

sources.auth: the rlkey query parameter is the credential; the st parameter is droppable
sources.archive_filename: PUBLIC - ONDO USDY LLC Daily Reports.zip
sources.timezone: report dates are calendar dates encoded in the filename; no timezone is stated
sources.selection_rule: Select by the report date in the filename. NEVER select by archive member modification time — 126 of 150 2026 files carry a bulk-reupload mtime of 2026-07-09.
sources.known_gap: One weekday, 2026-03-31, has no report and no stated reason. A missing report is SOURCE_ERROR, never a fabricated value.
sources.failure_semantics: Retrieval failure, a rotated rlkey, or a missing report are all SOURCE_ERROR. None is an assertion about collateral.
sources.url_observed_note: Deliberately not recorded. The observed URL carries the rotating rlkey, and this manifest states the credential must never be persisted; recording it here would have contradicted that. Rediscover it from ondo-usdy-page on every run.
sources.fixture_disposition: blocked: reachable only inside a 260 MB archive; pulling it was ruled against

retrieval_problem.detail: The whole archive is a single 260,431,605-byte zip. The prior audit recorded that a 2026 year-subfolder of about 35.9 MB could be fetched instead. That is not reproducible with this URL form: a HEAD against the folder URL with and without subpath=%2F2026 returns the identical Content-Disposition filename and the identical Original-Content-Length of 260431605, so the subpath parameter is ignored.
retrieval_problem.consequence: As things stand a single daily observation would cost a 260 MB download, which is not a bounded retrieval and must not be scheduled as one.
retrieval_problem.before_PLAN_T10: A bounded mechanism must be found and verified — a per-file share link, a Dropbox API listing, an HTTP Range strategy, or an alternative publication route from the issuer. If none exists, the cost and cadence of USDY must be re-decided rather than absorbed silently.
further_attempts_2026_08_15: The folder page carries no embedded file listing; the served HTML contains no filenames.
No per-file share link and no HTTP Range support were found, consistent with the prior audit.
retrieval_problem.ruling: Do not pull the 260 MB archive. A one-time download would supply a fixture but would not make autonomous daily retrieval bounded, so it would not rescue PLAN-T10.

controls_intended.evidence: both figures are extractable as text from the attestation PDF; the 2026-08-07 report showed Token Principal 2,134,875,462.46 and Permitted Assets 2,142,264,400.29, a ratio of 1.003461
controls_intended.note: This is a real covenant test by a named third party, which is why USDY was selected.

controls_intended.predicate: a report exists for a business day within the documented three-business-day lag
controls_intended.note: separate from collateralisation; a stale archive is a freshness failure, not a covenant breach

traps: The USDY oracle self-accrues daily including weekends at roughly +0.00010916/day. An oracle value changing is NEVER evidence of freshness.
There are no per-file URLs and no HTTP Range support on the archive.
The rlkey rotates; it must be rediscovered every run and never persisted.
Archive member mtimes are unusable for lag except for 24 genuine timestamps.

limits.path_traversal: archive members with absolute paths or parent references must be rejected
limits.note: These limits are deliberately unset rather than guessed. PLAN-T10 sets them against a real archive; no PDF path exists in the codebase yet.

fixtures_status.reason: Acquiring a single attestation PDF requires either the 260 MB archive download or a bounded mechanism that has not been found. Downloading 260 MB to obtain one fixture was not done.
fixtures_status.consequence: USDY has no golden fixture. PLAN-T10 cannot be implemented reproducibly until one exists.
fixtures_status.human_follow_up: Open the Dropbox folder in a browser, download the single file 2026/08 August/Ondo USDY LLC_ATCAttest_260807.pdf, and commit it with its SHA-256.
